execution.isolation: For each case, expose only the named skill and that case's fixture. Do not expose this manifest or sibling cases.
execution.context: Run the case manually in a fresh session with a read-only reviewer and make the disputed finding explicit before any fix.
execution.evaluation: Compare the response with required and forbidden criteria after the turn finishes; do not evaluate generic coding etiquette.

cases.prompt: Use $consensus-change-review to review the change described in SCENARIO.md. The initial reviewer disputes whether the finding is valid. Do not modify files until the finding is resolved.

required.criterion: Exchange with the original reviewer at most twice, then use a fresh tie-breaker if the material finding remains disputed.
Do not apply or silently reject an unresolved finding; ask the user to adjudicate it.

forbidden: Modify the reviewed change before the finding is accepted
Treat disagreement as rejection without evidence
Allow the reviewer to edit implementation files
